KPlugin.Name: Tsunyx Launcher (Dialog): Center + Skip Taskbar
KPlugin.Description: Centers the Tsunyx Launcher (Dialog) fork's fixed-size window on screen and keeps it out of the taskbar/pager/switcher. Needed because a Wayland client cannot position its own toplevel window (x/y bindings in QML are silently ignored) and PlasmaCore.Dialog does not hide itself from the taskbar the way Kicker.DashboardWindow does.
